peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is tcid50 per cell?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: TCID50 is the tissue culture infectious dose defined as that dilution of virus required to infect 50% of the cell monolayers. There are several statistical approaches for analyzing the data generated (such as Probit formula or Spearman-Karber analysis).
